chapter_title_en: Pridon Tells Tariel Tidings of Nestan-Darejan
chapter_expert_explanation_en: Pridon recounts how he once saw from a headland two black slaves bring a moon-like maiden out of a chest on a boat before another ship carried her away. When Pridon's mariners cannot find her, Tariel retreats to the wilderness cave conquered from the Devis, where Asmat tends him. Deeply moved, Avtandil pledges to report back to Tinatin in Arabia and return within two months to help Tariel find Nestan-Darejan.
